summary: Iteration 82 - MAJOR UI Overhaul Testing Complete: MAARS branding, gallery view, dashboard improvements, and agent visibility toggle all verified working. 13/13 backend tests passed. All 15 frontend test points verified via Playwright UI testing.

minor.issue: Single agent GET doesn't include tools array (tools only in list endpoint)
Gallery page with 458 agent thumbnails triggers avatar loading rate limits (CDN)

login.details: Login with management.maars@marsgc.net / Admin123! works correctly

landing_page_branding.details: MAARS logo in navbar (/branding/maars-logo.jpeg), blue-cyan gradient on 'Get Started' button, footer logo present

login_page_branding.details: MAARS logo on left panel, blue-cyan gradient 'Sign In' button

dashboard_command_center.details: Command Center header, stats grid (Active Projects, Completed, Agents Working, Total Projects), Quick Actions (New Chat, Create Task, Create Agent)

dashboard_agent_hover.details: Agent cards show hover preview popup with agent avatar, name, role, capabilities, description

agents_page_cards_view.details: Default cards view shows 458 full agent cards with name, role, capabilities, tools, Start Chat button

agents_page_gallery_view.details: Gallery view shows compact 12-column grid (xl:grid-cols-12) with all 458 agent portrait thumbnails

gallery_hover_preview.details: Gallery hover shows preview tooltip with agent name, role, description, capabilities, tools count, 'Click to start chat'

view_toggle.details: View toggle buttons (data-testid='view-cards' and 'view-gallery') switch between views correctly

sidebar_maars_logo.details: Sidebar shows MAARS logo image (/branding/maars-logo.jpeg) at top

sidebar_credits.details: Sidebar shows credit balance (5483.00), plan badge (Business), '+ Buy Credits' button navigating to /pricing

watermark.details: Centered bottom watermark with MAARS logo + 'MAARS GLOBAL CORPORATION' text

agent_visibility_toggle_gallery.details: Eye icon toggle button (data-testid='toggle-visibility-{agent_id}') appears on gallery item hover for admin

agent_visibility_toggle_cards.details: Eye icon toggle button (data-testid='toggle-card-visibility-{agent_id}') appears on card hover for admin

visibility_api.details: PUT /api/agents/{agent_id}/visibility correctly toggles hidden status, returns { agent_id, hidden }

color_scheme.details: Deep navy backgrounds (#070721), electric blue (#3b82f6), cyan (#06b6d4) accents throughout. No indigo/violet remnants visible.

critical_code_review_comments: Agents.jsx: Gallery view uses responsive grid (4-12 cols), hover preview positioned dynamically to avoid viewport overflow
DashboardLayout.jsx: SidebarCredits component fetches /api/subscription every 30s, shows balance + plan + buy button
Watermark.jsx: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 with justify-center for proper centering
index.css: CSS variables define MAARS brand palette (--primary: 215 90% 55%, --accent: 190 85% 45%)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 82 fully verified. Key features: 1) Gallery view on /agents page with 12-col grid and hover preview, 2) Cards/Gallery view toggle, 3) Agent visibility toggle (eye icon) for admin users, 4) MAARS branding throughout (logo in navbar, sidebar, footer, watermark), 5) Credits display in sidebar with balance/plan/buy button, 6) Dashboard agent cards with hover preview showing details.
